title: Fix batch 2 — Settings, before and after

steps.headline: Backup & Sync — when sync fails: keep these changes?
steps.changed: The error is now a tinted box inside the sync card, with grey text and its buttons (Show details, Try again) inside it. "Add a backup" and "Back up all now" are full-width outlined buttons. "Sync log" is a boxed row with the arrow on the right.
steps.notice: No red text; "Show details" is a button; groups are 16px apart.
steps.risk: Outlined buttons look faint on this theme — see the outline question below.

steps.headline: Backup & Sync — everything fine: keep these changes?
steps.changed: Same rules on the normal screen: follow-up actions are full-width outlined buttons, the sync log is a boxed row, spacing is even.
steps.notice: "Back up all now" is a button, not underlined text.

steps.surface: Backup & Sync — too big to sync
steps.path: Backup & Sync with conversations over the size limit
steps.headline: Backup & Sync — too big to sync: keep these changes?
steps.changed: The warning box you picked is unchanged, but "Sync now" is now a full-width outlined button, and the box title is normal text colour.
steps.notice: The orange title text is now dark, like other text.

steps.headline: Remote Access: keep these changes?
steps.changed: "Generate" is gone. "Set" is a small filled button inside the password box. The top is a plain intro and one status row — no box inside a box. Labels lose capitals.
steps.notice: Fewer boxes on the screen. The top block's final look is still provisional.
steps.risk: Keep awake is unchanged (its own redesign is on the roadmap).

steps.path: Permissions → turn on Skip Permissions Mode
steps.headline: Skip Permissions confirm: keep these changes?
steps.changed: The whole "I understand…" line is one tappable box with the tick on the left. "Turn it on" stays disabled until it is ticked. Buttons stay stacked.
steps.notice: The line lights up when ticked (shown in the next slide).

steps.headline: Skip Permissions ticked: is this lit state right?
steps.changed: Ticking the line lights it up with a tinted border and background; the red button becomes active.

steps.headline: Local models — downloads: keep these changes?
steps.changed: No coloured strips. An interrupted or damaged download is a notice box inside its card, with its buttons (Delete, Resume) inside the box. "Settings" and "Add vision" are outlined buttons.
steps.notice: Errors look like Backup & Sync's warnings.

steps.headline: Local models — download interrupted: keep these changes?
steps.changed: The same notice box for an interrupted download, shown lower on the page.
steps.notice: The title is normal text, not yellow-on-yellow.

steps.headline: Specialists: keep these changes?
steps.changed: The gap under the heading is 8px. The capital "READ-ONLY" chips are normal-case tinted pills. The count line reads "Available specialists 7" with a "1 warning" pill.
steps.notice: The intro sits right under its heading.

steps.headline: About: keep these changes?
steps.changed: Small labels lose their spaced capitals; labels over reading text get the soft underline.
